annotations.title: Token price lookup, USD: live crypto price by symbol or contract address

description: Token price in USD for any crypto token by symbol (ETH, BTC, LINK, AERO, ARB, OP), coin name or ERC-20 address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism, read live from the deepest Uniswap v3 pool, with the pool, fee tier, reserve and a thin-liquidity flag. Use to get a crypto price for a quote, a portfolio valuation or a trade check. Example: symbol=ETH. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: 0x ERC-20 token contract address (instead of symbol)

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb or op

symbol.description: Ticker such as ETH, BTC, USDC, AERO, ARB, OP or LINK (instead of address; ETH and BTC mean the wrapped tokens)
